title: Overlay Manifest
description: The document a domain overlay publishes to declare its namespace and the vocabulary it owns within that namespace, without ever naming a vendor/model. The schema is closed at every level (additionalProperties: false) so no vendor/model field can ever be added.

overlay_id.description: An opaque identifier; must not encode a vendor/model name (same rule as CapabilityAdvertisement.executor_id, docs/ontology.md).

version.description: The overlay's own semver, distinct from spec_version.

requested_capability_kinds.description: Promise.kind-shaped strings this overlay's graphs may request; open vocabulary, never a vendor/model name.

namespacedString.$comment: Namespace-dotted form. The schema cannot check that the dotted prefix actually equals this instance's own `namespace` value -- that cross-field check is load_manifest's job.
